<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#3EB3F9"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="25" font-family="Roboto" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
    <line x1="330" y1="18" x2="330" y2="24" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="335" y1="15" x2="335" y2="24" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="340" y1="12" x2="340" y2="24" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="345" y1="9" x2="345" y2="24" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="358" cy="19" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="361" y1="22" x2="365" y2="26" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="371" y="13" width="17" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="373" y="15" width="11" height="7" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="388" y="16" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- top header -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="30" cy="61" r="19" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="30" y="68" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#0901A7">P</text>
    <text x="58" y="67" font-family="Roboto" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">PayPal</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="313" y="47" width="57" height="30" rx="15" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.2"/>
      <text x="341" y="67" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Skip</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- hero copy -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="117" font-family="Roboto" font-size="28" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Money, made simple.</text>
    <text x="22" y="143" font-family="Roboto" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">One secure place for your everyday payments.</text>
    <text x="22" y="163" font-family="Roboto" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Send, spend, and manage your balance with ease.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- angled phone shadow -->
  <g transform="translate(100 174) rotate(8 95 260)">
    <rect x="8" y="9" width="190" height="405" rx="28" fill="#0275BA" opacity="0.28"/>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="190" height="405" rx="28" fill="#110055"/>
    <rect x="7" y="8" width="176" height="389" rx="22" fill="#F7FBFE"/>
    <rect x="73" y="14" width="60" height="6" rx="3" fill="#C2C2C2"/>
    <text x="22" y="48" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#676767">Good morning, Maya</text>
    <circle cx="160" cy="43" r="13" fill="#9FD9FC"/>
    <text x="160" y="47" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#0901A7">M</text>

    <!-- phone balance card -->
    <rect x="17" y="63" width="156" height="104" rx="14" fill="#0901A7"/>
    <text x="30" y="86" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#9FD9FC">PayPal balance</text>
    <text x="30" y="119" font-family="Roboto" font-size="27" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">$1,248.56</text>
    <text x="30" y="143" font-family="Roboto" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#9FD9FC">Available to spend</text>
    <circle cx="151" cy="145" r="10" fill="#3EB3F9"/>
    <line x1="146" y1="145" x2="156" y2="145" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="151" y1="140" x2="151" y2="150" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>

    <!-- phone actions -->
    <circle cx="45" cy="196" r="19" fill="#9FD9FC"/>
    <line x1="38" y1="196" x2="52" y2="196" stroke="#0901A7" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="45" y1="189" x2="45" y2="203" stroke="#0901A7" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="45" y="229" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#28308A">Add money</text>
    <circle cx="96" cy="196" r="19" fill="#FFD469"/>
    <polyline points="88,196 94,202 105,190" fill="none" stroke="#110055" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="96" y="229" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#28308A">Pay</text>
    <circle cx="147" cy="196" r="19" fill="#E2A042"/>
    <polyline points="140,195 147,188 154,195" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="140,198 147,205 154,198" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="147" y="229" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#28308A">Send</text>

    <!-- phone activity -->
    <text x="19" y="263" font-family="Roboto" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#110055">Recent activity</text>
    <text x="133" y="263" font-family="Roboto" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#0275BA">See all</text>
    <line x1="19" y1="273" x2="171" y2="273" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="35" cy="296" r="15" fill="#FFD469"/>
    <text x="35" y="300" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#110055">S</text>
    <text x="58" y="294" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#110055">Sofia Ramirez</text>
    <text x="58" y="309" font-family="Roboto" font-size="9" font-weight="400" fill="#676767">Payment received · Today</text>
    <text x="151" y="300" text-anchor="end" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#0275BA">+$42.00</text>
    <line x1="19" y1="322" x2="171" y2="322" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="35" cy="345" r="15" fill="#9FD9FC"/>
    <text x="35" y="349" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#0901A7">C</text>
    <text x="58" y="343" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#110055">Cloud Market</text>
    <text x="58" y="358" font-family="Roboto" font-size="9" font-weight="400" fill="#676767">Purchase · Yesterday</text>
    <text x="151" y="349" text-anchor="end" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#110055">−$18.75</text>
    <rect x="65" y="379" width="60" height="4" rx="2" fill="#C2C2C2"/>

  <!-- feature card shadows -->
  <rect x="16" y="594" width="358" height="86" rx="16" fill="#0275BA" opacity="0.2"/>
  <rect x="16" y="591" width="358" height="86" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- feature 1 -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="48" cy="620" r="20" fill="#9FD9FC"/>
    <rect x="38" y="613" width="20" height="14" rx="2" fill="#0901A7"/>
    <line x1="41" y1="618" x2="55" y2="618" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="623" r="2" fill="#FFD469"/>
    <text x="79" y="616" font-family="Roboto" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#110055">Your balance, at a glance</text>
    <text x="79" y="638" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#676767">Know what you have and where it goes.</text>
    <text x="79" y="657" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#0275BA">Track every dollar</text>
  </g>

  <!-- feature card 2 -->
  <rect x="16" y="689" width="358" height="86" rx="16" fill="#0275BA" opacity="0.2"/>
  <rect x="16" y="686" width="358" height="86" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <g>
    <circle cx="48" cy="715" r="20" fill="#FFD469"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="711" r="7" fill="#110055"/>
    <ellipse cx="48" cy="725" rx="11" ry="6" fill="#110055"/>
    <line x1="42" y1="711" x2="54" y2="711" stroke="#FFD469" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="79" y="711" font-family="Roboto" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#110055">Pay and link with confidence</text>
    <text x="79" y="733" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#676767">Connect your bank and move money securely.</text>
    <text x="79" y="752" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#0275BA">Explore payment tools</text>
  </g>

  <!-- CTA -->
  <g>
    <rect x="87" y="785" width="216" height="42" rx="21" fill="#0901A7"/>
    <text x="195" y="812" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Get started</text>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="829" width="390" height="15" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.12"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="41,835 49,828 57,835 57,842 51,842 51,837 47,837 47,842 41,842" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="49" y="843" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="8" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Home</text>
    <circle cx="129" cy="834" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="134" y1="839" x2="139" y2="843" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <rect x="204" y="829" width="14" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polygon points="207,839 211,842 214,839" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="211" y="843" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="8" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Pay</text>
    <circle cx="294" cy="834" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="294" cy="832" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="288" y="836" width="12" height="5" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="294" y="843" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="8" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Wallet</text>
    <circle cx="356" cy="834" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="356" cy="840" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="351" y1="834" x2="361" y2="834" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="351" y1="840" x2="361" y2="840" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="356" y="843" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="8" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">More</text>
  </g>
</svg>
